in_sanskrit.name: अदिऊथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: अदि (Adi) - the first one, उथ (uth) - to rise. The one who rises first.

in_hindi.name: अदिउठ
in_hindi.long_meaning: पहला (pahla) - first, प्रथम (pratham) - first, उथ (uth) - to rise. The first one to rise.

in_tamil.name: அடிூத
in_tamil.long_meaning: முதல் (mutal) - first, வர் (var) - to come, அடி (adi) - beginning, ஊத (uth) - to rise. The first one to come or rise.

in_telugu.name: అదిూఠ
in_telugu.long_meaning: పది (padi) - first, జే (je) - to be, అది (adi) - beginning, ఊఠ (uth) - to rise. The first one to be or rise.

in_marathi.name: Adiuth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Adiuth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Adiuth is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Adi’, which means ‘beginning’ or ‘primordial’. In Hindu mythology, Adi is also known as the first god and the creator of the universe.
